notes.title: RANDOBOUNCE - Full release OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h3]🎉🎊🥳 Exciting News! 🥳🎊🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]The time has come. After a long wait of ~10 months, I can finally release the full game I imagined RANDOBOUNCE to be.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="AypMQYYaGf4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]
RANDOBOUNCE[/b] is a minimalistic, fast-paced, arcade, score-attack roguelike where chaos is your best weapon.[/p][p][/p][p]You have no control over movement, [i]just bouncing![/i][/p][p]But you [i]do[/i] have control over the firepower.[/p][p][/p][p]Build the ultimate weapon by combining multiple [b]Barrels[/b], each firing different types of [b]Bullets[/b], from homing missiles to explosive rounds. Every upgrade shapes your weapon into a unique, enemy-shredding machine. Tweak individual stats, from the [i]Fire Rate[/i], to the [i]Rotation[/i] of each Barrel.[/p][p][/p][p]Survive for 20 minutes while racking up the highest score possible. Along the way, collect [b]Power-Ups[/b] that provide game-changing [i]offensive[/i] and [i]defensive[/i] perks.[/p][p][/p][p]Bounce, power-up and climb up the leaderboard ranks![/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features since the Demo:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Integration:[/b] Cloud Saves, Stats, Achievements and a LEADERBOARD![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Bullets and Power-Ups: [/b]New set of Bullets for even more powerfull combinations, as well as unique Power-Ups.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessibility Settings[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Balancing Chages:[/b] After reading all the feedback suggestions, I tweaked some difficulty settings and implemented new features for an easier gameplay, while mantaining the desired base difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Don't forget to share [b]RANDOBOUNCE [/b]with family and friends if you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][h3][i]Remember, you are at the mercy of BOUNCING![/i][/h3]
